title: Commission sets out next chapter for European Capitals of Culture after over 40 years of success
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 10 Sep 2026 Today, the European Commission renews and strengthens the framework for the European Capitals of Culture beyond 2033, applying the lessons of more than 40 years of experience into the programme's next generation.
